title: Ezra Bible Quiz - Chapter 8
description: Ten questions on Ezra 8: the journey from the river Ahava to Jerusalem with the temple treasures.

questions.text: Where did the narrator gather the people and camp for three days?
questions.explanation: Ezra 8:15 says "I gathered them together to the river that runs to Ahava; and there we encamped three days."

answers.text: At the river that runs to Ahava
At the brook Kidron by the city

questions.text: Whom did the narrator find missing when he looked over the people?
questions.explanation: Ezra 8:15 says he looked at the people and the priests and found none of the sons of Levi.

questions.text: To whom were men sent at the place Casiphia?
questions.explanation: Ezra 8:17 says they were sent to Iddo the chief at Casiphia, to bring ministers for the house of God.

questions.text: Why was a fast proclaimed at the river Ahava?
questions.explanation: Ezra 8:21 says it was to humble themselves before God and seek a straight way for themselves, their little ones and their possessions.

answers.text: To mourn the death of the king of Persia
To prepare themselves for the Passover feast
To ask God for rain on the land of Judah
To seek from God a straight way for the journey

questions.text: Why was the narrator ashamed to ask the king for soldiers and horsemen?
questions.explanation: Ezra 8:22 says they had told the king that the hand of their God is on all who seek him, for good.

answers.text: They had told the king God's hand is on all who seek him
The king had already refused him once
They already had many soldiers of their own
The road was known to be completely safe

questions.text: How many of the chiefs of the priests were set apart?
questions.explanation: Ezra 8:24 says: "I set apart twelve of the chiefs of the priests."

questions.text: What was said to the men who received the silver, gold and vessels?
questions.explanation: Ezra 8:28 says: "You are holy to Yahweh, and the vessels are holy."

answers.text: "Hide them until the wall is built"
"Give them to the governor beyond the River"
"Sell them and buy bulls and rams"
"You are holy to Yahweh, and the vessels are holy"

questions.text: When did they depart from the river Ahava?
questions.explanation: Ezra 8:31 says they departed on the twelfth day of the first month.

answers.text: On the first day of the fifth month
On the twelfth day of the first month
On the seventh day of the third month
On the twentieth day of the ninth month

questions.text: Into whose hand were the silver, gold and vessels weighed in God's house?
questions.explanation: Ezra 8:33 says they were weighed into the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriah the priest.

questions.text: What did they deliver to the king's local governors?
questions.explanation: Ezra 8:36 says they delivered the king's commissions to the king's local governors and the governors beyond the River.
